heading:
People before technology.
Technology for people.
paragraphs: An ongoing attempt to make sense of the messy, complicated, and often absurd experience of being human. Why we think the way we think, and do the things we do. How the systems we create inevitably shape us in return, and whether the technology we're building actually makes anything better.
Connecting dots, questioning assumptions, noticing patterns. Pulling at threads to see where they lead, or if they lead anywhere at all.
